en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modern hillside hotel building partly hidden by pine trees. In the foreground there is a stone terrace and stairway with a reclining nude female statue placed on a low stone wall. A person walks up the steps toward the hotel. The reverse side contains printed Hungarian text identifying the location and sculpture, a green Hungarian postage stamp, a Pécs postmark, and handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address.
